overview: This 532-page file documents Japanese political affairs under the Allied occupation in 1947. It combines diplomatic reporting on parties, coalition negotiations, labor, purges, and foreign reactions with election laws, observer guidance, and analyses of the April elections. A substantial historical report traces socialist, communist, agrarian, labor, and nationalist movements from the prewar period through 1945.
interest: Party interviews, election observer instructions, and detailed movement histories reveal how occupation officials assessed Japan’s emerging democracy.
